fusions.name: Unyielding Clench
fusions.desc: Seizes the target in a cold grip and squeezes its plates in, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven Nail
fusions.desc: Drives a cold nail at one enemy up to 6 tiles away for 32 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It ignores the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Unbending Stance
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold-Forged Grip
fusions.desc: When you take damage that is not fire, you gain a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
